item.title: NSF leadership in a new golden age of science
item.description: The U.S. National Science Foundation was established in 1950 to keep American discovery at the frontier. That mission remains unchanged.

item.title: Interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS rich in methanol
item.description: Interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS contains exceptionally high levels of methanol, suggesting it formed under conditions very different from those shaping other comets.
